description: Cases for the search that the `forbidden` patterns of a configuration use, in the shape of the cases of patterns.json. `finds` and `findsNot`: a part of each string in `finds` must match, and no part of a string in `findsNot` may; the search with its shortcut and the search that tries every position must agree on each, and so must the engine of the language, given the pattern as it is. `required`, where a case has it, is the text the package derives that every match contains (the empty string when it derives none): a value without that text is not tried. The cases named `generated` were produced from a fixed seed, and their expectations are those of an ECMAScript engine.
